texts:
Wednesday's practice reports are in, and the Week 5 injury list got longer.

Lamar Jackson missed practice.

Both Chicago backs sat.

Jayden Daniels practiced in full.
#RavensFlock #DaBears #RaiseHail

Lamar Jackson missed Wednesday's practice with the left ankle. Jesse Minter will judge him through the week before Sunday night @ATL.

QB2 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#RavensFlock

Zay Flowers missed Wednesday's practice with a hamstring after 8 catches for 118 and a TD vs TEN.

WR9 for me this week. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Tyler Huntley starts if Jackson sits. Stash him in superflex, 6 to 10 percent.
#RavensFlock

Jayden Daniels practiced in full Wednesday on the left elbow. A full practice by Friday puts him back vs NYG.

QB11 for me, a borderline start this week.
#RaiseHail #NYGiants

Stefon Diggs and Terry McLaurin both missed Wednesday's practice for Washington.

Diggs led the receivers in London and is WR23 for me, a WR2, if he plays. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.
#RaiseHail

Malik Nabers missed Wednesday's practice with a sore knee after 6 catches for 112 and a TD vs ARI.

WR10 for me this week @WAS. Monitor; Thursday's practice report.

Cam Skattebo was limited with the shoulder. RB19 for me, an RB2.
#NYGiants

Kyle Monangai missed Wednesday's practice with thumb and toe injuries after 30 carries for 146 and 2 TD. The coach says the thumb is fine.

RB18 for me, an RB2. Monitor; Friday's injury report.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

D'Andre Swift also missed Wednesday's practice, with hip and knee injuries.

RB13 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week vs GB. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Tyson Bagent starts with Caleb Williams out again.
#DaBears #GoPackGo

Alvin Kamara did not practice Wednesday with the back he hurt Monday, and Travis Etienne is already out.

Kamara is a high-end RB3 for me. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Kendre Miller is next up, RB40 for me, a low-end flex play.
#Saints

Chris Olave sat out Wednesday as a rest day after Monday's late hit.

WR7 for me this week vs MIN.

Tyler Shough was limited with his left hand wrapped and says he will play. QB12 for me, a borderline start this week.
#Saints #Skol

Justin Jefferson was limited Wednesday in his first practice since the Week 3 ankle sprain.

WR6 rest of season for me; hold him. Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Jordan Addison sat with minor soreness. A high-end WR3 for me @NO if he plays.
#Skol #Saints

Tee Higgins did not practice Wednesday, and the report added a neck injury to the groin.

Monitor; Friday's injury report.

Ja'Marr Chase stayed in the concussion protocol and is WR45 for me. Monitor; his protocol steps through Friday.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Mike Gesicki is the Bengals piece to use with both receivers sitting Wednesday.

TE11 for me, a borderline start this week @MIA.

Chase Brown caught 10 passes for 62 last week. RB5 for me.
#WhoDey #PhinsUp

Ashton Jeanty practiced in full Wednesday on the ankle that cut into his snaps vs KC.

RB11 for me, borderline RB1/RB2 this week @NE.

Brock Bowers was limited with the knee. TE2 for me.
#RaiderNation #NEPats

Mack Hollins missed Wednesday's practice with the calf again.

Romeo Doubs scored twice at BUF with Hollins hurt. A high-end WR3 for me, a high-end flex play vs LV.
#NEPats #RaiderNation

Breece Hall missed Wednesday's practice with the quad.

Braelon Allen took all 14 back carries without him @CHI. RB20 for me this week, an RB2.
#JetUp

Tank Dell returned to practice Wednesday after missing all of 2025. Houston has 21 days to activate him, and he has no snaps yet.

Stash him in deep leagues, 0 to 2 percent of FAAB.
#HTownMade

Baker Mayfield is out Thursday @DAL and is aiming for Week 6 vs PIT.

QB24 rest of season for me. Monitor; his practice reps the week of Week 6.
#GoBucs #DallasCowboys

Rico Dowdle is on track to return vs IND after Jaylen Warren played 69 of 71 snaps at CLE.

Dowdle is a monitor; his snaps vs IND.

Warren is RB8 for me this week.
#HereWeGo #ForTheShoe

Bhayshul Tuten out-snapped Chris Rodriguez Jr. 36 to 15 @CIN and had two TDs called back.

RB15 for me this week vs PHI in London, an RB2. Trade for him now.
#DUUUVAL #FlyEaglesFly

Every call from today, with the practice reports behind it, is on the Pass page. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for Thursday's lineup calls, and send this to the Bears fan in your league.
